overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by not creating minutes of its May 31, 2016 meeting, but since the Board created them on December 13, 2016 after the complaint, it ordered no further relief. The minutes-accuracy claim was declined because it was raised first in the appeal.

allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board's failure to create minutes for the May 31, 2016 meeting violated the Open Meeting Law.
